title: More museums, libraries, and public venues add sensory-friendly hours
summary: A growing number of museums, libraries, airports, and community venues are introducing dedicated sensory-friendly hours — dimmed lighting, reduced sound, and lower crowd density — to make public spaces more accessible to autistic visitors. Advocacy groups continue to publish guides for organizations hosting these events, and researchers have called for further participatory input from autistic people themselves in designing sensory-friendly 'zones.'
